title: Strict decrease of majority coefficients
statement: Let $m,j$ be nonnegative integers such that $2j+3\le m$. On the sign cube of dimension $2m+1$, take subsets $S,T$ with $|S|=2j+1$ and $|T|=2(j+1)+1$. The absolute Fourier coefficient of majority on $T$ is strictly smaller than the absolute Fourier coefficient on $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinates in dimension $2m+1$
$T$ is a subset of the coordinates in dimension $2m+1$
